gv_QRY_SELECT_FIS_INVOICE.value: ' SELECT DISTINCT        EXTRACT_HIST.BATCH_ID,        EXTRACT_HIST.BLEI_CK,        EXTRACT_HIST.GRGR_ID,        EXTRACT_HIST.BLIV_ID,        EXTRACT_HIST.BLBL_DUE_DT,        EXTRACT_HIST.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,        EXTRACT_HIST.BLSH_BILLED_AMT,        EXTRACT_HIST.IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE,        CASE            WHEN (EXCEP_HIST.IS_RECYCLED IS NOT NULL)            THEN                EXCEP_HIST.IS_RECYCLED            ELSE                EXTRACT_HIST.IS_RECYCLED        END            AS IS_RECYCLED   FROM (SELECT BATCHID                         AS BATCH_ID,                BLEI_CK,                GRGR_ID,                BLIV_ID,                BLBL_DUE_DT,                BLIV_CREATE_DTM,                BLSH_INVOICE_DTM,                BLSH_BILLED_AMT,                CASE                    WHEN [TYPE] = 'S'                    THEN                        'N'                    ELSE                        'Y'                END                    AS IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE,                'N'                             AS IS_RECYCLED           FROM FINANCE.STT_GBD_BLSH_TRANS_DATA_HIST          WHERE IS_EXCEP_EXISTS IS NULL AND BATCHID = 4655)        EXTRACT_HIST        LEFT OUTER JOIN        (SELECT DISTINCT                --0 AS BATCH_ID,                BLSH.BATCHID                       AS BATCH_ID,                EX.BLEI_CK,                BLSH.GRGR_ID,                EX.BLIV_ID,                EX.BLBL_DUE_DT,                EX.BLSH_INVOICE_DTM                AS BLIV_CREATE_DTM,                EX.SENT_BLSH_INVOICE_DTM,                CAST (EX.BLSH_BILLED_AMT AS MONEY) AS BLSH_BILLED_AMT,                CASE                    WHEN EX.[TYPE] = 'S'                    THEN                        'N'                    WHEN EX.[TYPE] IS NULL                    THEN                        CASE WHEN EX.[BLIV_ID] LIKE '%S' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                    ELSE                        'Y'                END                    AS IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE,                'Y'                                AS IS_RECYCLED           FROM FINANCE.FIS_EXCEPTION_HIST EX   (NOLOCK)    INNER JOIN FINANCE.STT_GBD_BLSH_TRANS_DATA_HIST BLSH (NOLOCK)     ON EX.BLIV_ID = BLSH.BLIV_ID     AND EX.[TYPE] = BLSH.[TYPE]  AND EX.UPDATED_DTM IS NOT NULL   AND BLSH.IS_EXCEP_EXISTS IS NULL AND BLSH.BATCHID = 4655    INNER JOIN Finance.Batch BTH     ON BLSH.BatchID = BTH.BatchId AND CAST(EX.UPDATED_DTM AS DATE) = CAST(BTH.RanDate  AS DATE)   AND EX.SENT_BLSH_INVOICE_DTM NOT BETWEEN BTH.BatchFromDate AND BTH.BatchDate AND BTH.BatchStatusId = 9  )EXCEP_HIST   ON EXTRACT_HIST.BLEI_CK = EXCEP_HIST.BLEI_CK   AND EXTRACT_HIST.BLIV_ID = EXCEP_HIST.BLIV_ID   AND EXTRACT_HIST.IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE = EXCEP_HIST.IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE'

gv_QRY_SELECT_FIS_INVOICE.defaultValue:
'SELECT DISTINCT
       EXTRACT_HIST.BATCH_ID,
       EXTRACT_HIST.BLEI_CK,
       EXTRACT_HIST.GRGR_ID,
       EXTRACT_HIST.BLIV_ID,
       EXTRACT_HIST.BLBL_DUE_DT,
       EXTRACT_HIST.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,
       EXTRACT_HIST.BLSH_BILLED_AMT,
       EXTRACT_HIST.IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE,
       CASE
           WHEN (EXCEP_HIST.IS_RECYCLED IS NOT NULL)
           THEN
               EXCEP_HIST.IS_RECYCLED
           ELSE
               EXTRACT_HIST.IS_RECYCLED
       END
           AS IS_RECYCLED
  FROM (SELECT BATCHID                         AS BATCH_ID,
               BLEI_CK,
               GRGR_ID,
               BLIV_ID,
               BLBL_DUE_DT,
               BLIV_CREATE_DTM,
               BLSH_INVOICE_DTM,
               BLSH_BILLED_AMT,
               CASE
                   WHEN [TYPE] = 'S'
                   THEN
                       'N'
                   ELSE
                       'Y'
               END
                   AS IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE,
               'N'                             AS IS_RECYCLED
          FROM FINANCE.STT_GBD_BLSH_TRANS_DATA_HIST
         WHERE IS_EXCEP_EXISTS IS NULL AND BATCHID = 4655)
       EXTRACT_HIST
       LEFT OUTER JOIN
       (SELECT DISTINCT
               --0 AS BATCH_ID,
               BLSH.BATCHID                       AS BATCH_ID,
               EX.BLEI_CK,
               BLSH.GRGR_ID,
               EX.BLIV_ID,
               EX.BLBL_DUE_DT,
               EX.BLSH_INVOICE_DTM                AS BLIV_CREATE_DTM,
               EX.SENT_BLSH_INVOICE_DTM,
               CAST (EX.BLSH_BILLED_AMT AS MONEY) AS BLSH_BILLED_AMT,
               CASE
                   WHEN EX.[TYPE] = 'S'
                   THEN
                       'N'
                   WHEN EX.[TYPE] IS NULL
                   THEN
                       CASE WHEN EX.[BLIV_ID] LIKE '%S' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
                   ELSE
                       'Y'
               END
                   AS IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE,
               'Y'                                AS IS_RECYCLED
          FROM FINANCE.FIS_EXCEPTION_HIST EX   (NOLOCK)
   INNER JOIN FINANCE.STT_GBD_BLSH_TRANS_DATA_HIST BLSH (NOLOCK)
    ON EX.BLIV_ID = BLSH.BLIV_ID
    AND EX.[TYPE] = BLSH.[TYPE]  AND EX.UPDATED_DTM IS NOT NULL   AND BLSH.IS_EXCEP_EXISTS IS NULL AND BLSH.BATCHID = 4655
   INNER JOIN Finance.Batch BTH
    ON BLSH.BatchID = BTH.BatchId AND CAST(EX.UPDATED_DTM AS DATE) = CAST(BTH.RanDate
 AS DATE)   AND EX.SENT_BLSH_INVOICE_DTM NOT BETWEEN BTH.BatchFromDate AND BTH.BatchDate AND BTH.BatchStatusId = 9
 )EXCEP_HIST
  ON EXTRACT_HIST.BLEI_CK = EXCEP_HIST.BLEI_CK
  AND EXTRACT_HIST.BLIV_ID = EXCEP_HIST.BLIV_ID
  AND EXTRACT_HIST.IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE = EXCEP_HIST.IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE'
